description: This is a test source file containing unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, testing URL trust validation logic in an Android project.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust utility.

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that a known scaffold asset URL is trusted.

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Tests that a specific trusted A2UI page URL is accepted.

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Ensures URLs from different origins are not trusted even if the path matches.

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Verifies that untrusted paths on a trusted origin are rejected.

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Confirms that URLs differing only by fragment are trusted.

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Checks that URLs with mismatched query parameters are rejected.

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Ensures that descendant paths under the trusted A2UI root are rejected if not explicitly trusted.
